about.title: Full-stack engineer. AI consultant. Problem solver.
paragraphs: I'm Michael — a full-stack developer and system architect based in Auckland, New Zealand. Technical Lead at a global leading fintech company, where I design and build mission-critical systems at scale.

Over the past 15+ years, I've delivered custom software for businesses across fintech, e-commerce, hospitality, logistics, and professional services. When off-the-shelf software doesn't cut it, I build solutions that do — from ERP systems and warehouse management to modern React SPAs.
Beyond fintech, I consult independently on AI integration: LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, AI agent workflows, and helping businesses understand where AI can create real value — not just hype.
